headlines.description: Matthew Stafford tied a career high with five touchdown passes, three of them to Calvin Johnson, lifting the Detroit Lions to a 45-14 rout of the Philadelphia Eagles on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford throws 5 TDs to lift Lions to 45-14 win over Eagles

headlines.description: Cam Newton is still perfect this season. Tony Romo might be out for good with the same injury that sidelined him for seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers lean on D to remain perfect

events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw for 200 yards and a score, and the Chicago Bears held off the Green Bay Packers on fourth-and-goal from the 8 with 22 seconds left for a 17-13 victory Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler, Bears hold off Packers at rainy Lambeau

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson ran for 158 yards and a pair of touchdowns, Matt Ryan threw two more interceptions, and the Minnesota Vikings beat the slumping Atlanta Falcons 20-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson runs for 2 TDs; Vikings beat Falcons

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw three touchdown passes -- two of them to A.J. Green -- and the Cincinnati Bengals ended their brief skid with a 31-7 victory over the St. Louis Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton's 3 TD passes lead Bengals over Rams

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw a 12-yard touchdown pass to Seth Roberts with 1:21 left, and the Oakland Raiders stopped a three-game skid by edging the Tennessee Titans 24-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr throws TD with 1:21 left as Raiders edge Titans 24-21

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Matt Hasselbeck threw for 315 yards and two touchdowns and Adam Vinatieri made four more field goals, leading the Indianapolis Colts to a 25-12 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hasselbeck, Vinatieri lead Colts past Buccaneers 25-12

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw for 255 yards and two touchdowns, Spencer Ware ran for 114 yards and a score, and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the Buffalo Bills Sunday in a matchup of AFC wild-card hopefuls.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs hold off Bills 30-22 for 5th straight win

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw four touchdown passes, two to Brandon Marshall, and the New York Jets routed the Miami Dolphins 38-20 Sunday to gain some traction in the AFC wild-card race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fitzpatrick, Marshall lead Jets past Dolphins 38-20

events.name: New York Giants at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw a 63-yard touchdown pass to DeSean Jackson and scored on a quarterback sneak, Washington intercepted Eli Manning three times and the Redskins beat the New York Giants Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins beat Giants 20-14 to pull into NFC East tie at 5-6

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw four touchdown passes, two to Antonio Gates, and the San Diego Chargers beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 31-25 and ended a six-game losing streak Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers' 4 TD passes help Chargers beat Jags 31-25, end skid

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Brian Hoyer threw for 205 yards and two touchdowns and Houston's defense stifled Drew Brees to help the Texans to a 24-6 win over the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans top Saints 24-6 for 4th consecutive win

headlines.description: Carson Palmer ran for a go-ahead 8-yard touchdown with 2:28 left and tumbled after spiking the ball in a telling story of his day, and the Arizona Cardinals squeaked by the San Francisco 49ers 19
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer's 8-yard TD run leads first-place Cards past 49ers

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw a career-high five touchdown passes, including two TDs to Doug Baldwin in the final 8:12, and the Seattle Seahawks held on for a wild 39-30 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers a
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson's 5 TDs lead Seattle past Pittsburgh 39-30

events.name: New England Patriots at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: C.J. Anderson scored on a 48-yard run with 12:32 left in overtime to power the Broncos to a 30-24 win and hand the Patriots their first loss of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos' OT TD march deals Patriots first loss

headlines.description: Will Hill returned a blocked field goal 64 yards for a touchdown as expired to give the Baltimore Ravens a 34-27 win over the luckless Cleveland Browns on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens return blocked FG as time expires to win
